name: Anti-cheat notice
author: Cell
summary: Explains why online modes of games protected by kernel anti-cheat may refuse to start.
useWhen: A game's online mode refuses to start or kicks you out with an anti-cheat error (Easy Anti-Cheat, BattlEye).

notes: This game ships Easy Anti-Cheat or BattlEye. Single-player usually works; online modes only work if the developer enabled anti-cheat support for Wine/Proton.

diagnostics.title: Anti-cheat refused to start
diagnostics.advice: Try the game's offline or single-player mode.
